units.zh: 天成四年春正月壬申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。
units.en: On the renshen new moon of the first month of Tiancheng 4 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Chongyuan Hall with the usual guard.
units.literal: In spring, first month of Tiancheng 4, on the renshen new moon the Emperor held audience at the Chongyuan Hall and received congratulations; guards and escort followed the usual rite.

units.zh: 幽州節度使趙德鈞奏：「臣孫讚，年五歲，默念《論語》、《孝經》，舉童子，於汴州取解就試。」
units.en: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou reported: "My grandson Zan, five years old, memorized the Analects and Classic of Filial Piety as a child candidate and sought to sit the qualifying exams at Bian."
units.literal: Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun memorialized: "Your servant's grandson Zan, five years old, recites from memory the Analects and Classic of Filial Piety, passed the child-candidate examination, and begs leave to take qualifying examinations at Bian."

units.zh: 詔曰：「都尉之子，太尉之孫，能念儒書，備彰家訓，不勞就試，特與成名。
units.en: The court replied: "As son of a commandant and grandson of a grand commandant, reciting Confucian classics and showing family teaching, he need not sit the exam—
units.literal: An edict said: "Son of a commandant and grandson of a grand commandant, able to recite Confucian classics and clearly manifest family teaching, need not sit the examination—special passing is granted.

units.zh: 宜賜別敕及第，附今年春榜。」
units.en: grant a special patent and passing status, attached to this spring's list."
units.literal: A special edict and passing grade are fitting, attached to this year's spring list."

units.zh: 戊子，放元年應欠秋稅。
units.en: On wuzi unpaid autumn taxes owed from the inaugural year were remitted.
units.literal: On wuzi, unpaid autumn taxes due from the inaugural year were remitted.

units.zh: 以左衛上將軍安崇阮為黔南節度使。
units.en: Left Guard senior general An Chongruan became Qiannan commissioner.
units.literal: Left Guard senior general An Chongruan was made Qiannan military commissioner.

units.zh: 壬辰，回鶻入朝使掣撥等五人各授懷化司戈放還。
units.en: On renchen Huihu court envoy Chebo and five others were each made Huaihua Company Commanders and sent home.
units.literal: On renchen, Huihu court envoy Chebo and five others were each appointed Huaihua Company Commanders and sent home.

units.zh: 以北京副留守馮贇為宣徽使、判三司。
units.en: Beijing deputy regent Feng Yun became palace treasury commissioner and revenue overseer.
units.literal: Beijing deputy regent Feng Yun was made Palace Treasury Commissioner and overseer of the Revenue Commission.

units.zh: 戊戌，禁天下虛稱試攝銜。
units.en: On wuxu false use of provisional appointment titles was forbidden throughout the realm.
units.literal: On wuxu, false use throughout the realm of provisional appointment titles was forbidden.

units.zh: 西川孟知祥奏：「支屬刺史乞臣本道自署。」
units.en: Meng Zhixiang of Western Shu asked: "I beg that branch prefects be appointed by this circuit itself."
units.literal: Meng Zhixiang of Western Shu memorialized: "I beg that branch prefects be appointed by this circuit itself."

units.zh: 二月乙巳，王晏球奏，此月三日收復定州，獲王都首級，生擒契丹托諾等二千餘人。
units.en: On yisi in the second month Wang Yanqiu reported recovering Ding on the third, taking Wang Du's head and capturing over two thousand Khitan including Tuonuo alive.
units.literal: Second month, yisi: Wang Yanqiu memorialized that on the third of this month Ding prefecture had been recovered, Wang Du's head was taken, and more than two thousand Khitan including Tuonuo were captured alive.

units.zh: 百僚稱賀已畢，乃詔取今月二十四日車駕還東京。
units.en: After congratulations Mingzong ordered the court to return to the Eastern Capital on the twenty-fourth.
units.literal: When the hundred officials' congratulations were finished, an edict then set the twenty-fourth of this month for the imperial carriage to return to the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 辛亥，以北面行營招討使、宋州節度使王晏球為鄆州節度使，加兼侍中；
units.en: On xinhai Wang Yanqiu of Song became Yan commissioner with attendant-in-chief rank;
units.literal: On xinhai, northern campaign headquarters commissioner and Song prefecture military commissioner Wang Yanqiu was made Yan prefecture military commissioner with added concurrent Attendant-in-Chief;

units.zh: 以北面行營副招討使、滄州節度使李從敏為定州節度使；
units.en: Li Congmin of Cang became Ding commissioner;
units.literal: northern campaign deputy commissioner and Cang prefecture military commissioner Li Congmin was made Ding prefecture military commissioner;

units.zh: 以北面行營兵馬都監、鄭州防禦使張虔釗為滄州節度使；
units.en: and Zhang Qianzhao, northern campaign army supervisor and defense commissioner of Zhengzhou, became military governor of Cangzhou;
units.literal: northern campaign horse-army commander-in-chief and Zhengzhou defense commissioner Zhang Qianzhao was made Cang prefecture military commissioner;

units.zh: 幽州節度使趙德鈞加兼侍中。
units.en: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou received attendant-in-chief rank.
units.literal: Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was given added concurrent Attendant-in-Chief.

units.zh: 乙卯，以樞密使趙敬怡權知汴州軍州事。
units.en: On yimao Zhao Jingyi acted as regent at Bian.
units.literal: On yimao, Privy Commissioner Zhao Jingyi was ordered to act as regent of Bian prefecture military headquarters.

units.zh: 丙辰，邢州奏，定州送到偽太子李繼陶，已處置訖。
units.en: On bingchen Xing reported the false heir Li Jitao from Ding had been executed.
units.literal: On bingchen, Xing prefecture memorialized that the false heir Li Jitao sent from Ding had been disposed of.

units.zh: 辛酉，帝御咸安樓受定州俘馘，百官就列，宣露布於樓前，禮畢，以王都首級獻於太社。
units.en: On xinyou Mingzong at the Xian'an Tower received Ding captives, proclaimed the victory bulletin, and offered Wang Du's head at the Grand Shrine.
units.literal: On xinyou, the Emperor took the Xian'an Tower to receive Ding captives and heads; the hundred officials took their places; the victory bulletin was proclaimed before the tower; when the rite was finished, Wang Du's head was offered at the Grand Shrine of State.

units.zh: 王都男四人、弟一人，禿餒父子二人，並磔於市。
units.en: Wang Du's four sons and brother and the Tu Nei father and son were dismembered in the market.
units.literal: Wang Du's four sons, one younger brother, and the father-and-son pair Tu Nei were all dismembered in the market.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：尚書兵部宣露布於樓前，宣訖，尚書刑部侍郎張文寶奏曰：「逆賊王都首級請付所司。」
units.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says War at the Secretariat proclaimed the bulletin at the tower; when it ended Zhang Wenbao of Punishments asked that Wang Du's head be given to the proper office."
units.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: The Ministry of War of the Secretariat proclaimed the victory bulletin before the tower; when the proclamation ended, Vice Director of the Ministry of Punishments Zhang Wenbao memorialized: "The rebel Wang Du's head is requested to be delivered to the relevant office."

units.zh: 大理卿蕭希甫受之以出，獻於郊社，其王都男並蕃將等磔於開封橋。）〉
units.en: Judicial review director Xiao Xifu took it out and offered it at the suburban altars; Wang Du's sons and Tangut generals were dismembered at Kaifeng Bridge.)〉
units.literal: Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xiao Xifu received it and went out, offered it at the suburban altars, and Wang Du's sons and the Tangut generals were dismembered at Kaifeng Bridge.)〉

units.zh: 時露布之文，類制敕之體，蓋執筆者誤，頗為識者所嗤。
units.en: The bulletin read like an edict, a scribe's mistake that critics mocked.
units.literal: At the time the victory bulletin's text resembled the style of an edict—probably the scribe's error—and was much ridiculed by the knowing.

units.zh: 樞密使趙敬怡卒，贈太傅。
units.en: Zhao Jingyi died and was posthumously made grand mentor.
units.literal: Privy Commissioner Zhao Jingyi died and was posthumously given Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 以端明殿學士趙鳳權知汴州軍州事。
units.en: Zhao Feng acted as regent at Bian.
units.literal: Duanming Hall academician Zhao Feng was ordered to act as regent of Bian prefecture military headquarters.

units.zh: 甲子，車駕發汴州。
units.en: On jiazi Mingzong left Bian.
units.literal: On jiazi, the imperial carriage departed Bian prefecture.

units.zh: 丙寅，至鄭州。
units.en: On bingyin he reached Zheng.
units.literal: On bingyin, he reached Zheng prefecture.

units.zh: 賜左僕射致仕鄭玨錢二十萬。
units.en: Retired left vice director Zheng Jue received two hundred thousand cash.
units.literal: Retired Left Vice Director Zheng Jue was granted two hundred thousand in cash.

units.zh: 丁卯，宰相崔協卒，詔贈尚書右僕射。
units.en: On dingmao Cui Xie died and was posthumously made right vice director.
units.literal: On dingmao, Chancellor Cui Xie died; an edict posthumously gave Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 東都留守、太子少傅李琪等奉，至偃師縣奉迎。
units.en: Li Qi, Eastern Capital regent and crown prince junior tutor, welcomed him at Yanshi.
units.literal: Eastern Capital regent and Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi and others came out to welcome him at Yanshi county.

units.zh: 時琪奏章中有「敗契丹之凶黨，破真定之逆城」之言。
units.en: Li Qi's welcome memorial called the Khitan a "villain faction" and Zhending a "rebel city."
units.literal: At the time Qi's memorial had the words "defeated the Khitan villain faction" and "broke the rebel city of Zhending."

units.zh: 詔曰：「契丹即為凶黨，真定不是逆城，李琪罰一月俸。」
units.en: Mingzong fined Li Qi one month's salary for calling the Khitan villains and Zhending a rebel city."
units.literal: An edict said: "If the Khitan are already a villain faction, Zhending is not a rebel city—Li Qi is fined one month's salary."

units.zh: 庚午，車駕至自汴州。
units.en: On gengwu Mingzong arrived from Bian.
units.literal: On gengwu, the imperial carriage arrived from Bian prefecture.

units.zh: 三月甲戌，馮道進表乞命相。
units.en: On jiaxu in the third month Feng Dao asked to be made chief minister.
units.literal: Third month, jiaxu: Feng Dao submitted a memorial begging appointment as chief minister.

units.zh: 丙戌，詔皇城使李從璨貶授房州司戶參軍，仍令盡命。
units.en: On bingxu Li Congcan was demoted to Fang registrar and ordered to take his own life.
units.literal: On bingxu, an edict demoted Imperial City commissioner Li Congcan to Fang prefecture registrar and still ordered his life ended.

units.zh: 從璨，帝之諸子也。
units.en: Congcan was Mingzong's son.
units.literal: Congcan was one of the Emperor's sons.

units.zh: 先是，帝巡幸汴州，留從璨以警大內，從璨因遊會節園，酒酣，戲登禦榻。
units.en: While Mingzong was at Bian he had left Congcan guarding the palace; drunk in the Festival Garden Congcan climbed the imperial couch in play.
units.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor toured Bian prefecture he left Congcan to guard the inner palace; Congcan, while drunk at the Festival Garden, climbed the imperial couch in play.

units.zh: 安重誨奏之，故置於法焉。
units.en: An Chonghui reported him and he was punished.
units.literal: An Chonghui reported it, so he was punished by law.

units.zh: 壬辰，中書奏：「今後群臣內有乞假覲省者，請量賜茶藥。」
units.en: On renchen the secretariat asked that ministers on leave for family visits be given tea and medicine."
units.literal: On renchen, the Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter, among the ministers, those who beg leave to visit kin, please grant tea and medicine as appropriate."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 乙未，以前鄆州節度使符習為汴州節度使。
units.en: On yiwei Fu Xi of Yan became Bian commissioner.
units.literal: On yiwei, former Yan prefecture military commissioner Fu Xi was made Bian prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 丙申，詔鄴都、幽、鎮、滄、邢、易、定等州管內百姓，除正稅外，放免諸色差配，以討王都之役，有挽運之勞也。
units.en: On bingshen Mingzong remitted extra levies in Yedu, You, Zhen, Cang, Xing, Yi, and Ding beyond regular tax after the Wang Du campaign's transport burden.
units.literal: On bingshen, an edict for the commoners within the circuits of Yedu, You, Zhen, Cang, Xing, Yi, and Ding, besides regular tax, remitted every sort of differential levy, because of the labor of hauling in the campaign against Wang Du.

units.zh: 夏四月庚子朔，禁鐵鑞錢。
units.en: On the gengzi new moon of the fourth month iron pewter coin was banned.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengzi new moon: iron pewter coins were forbidden.

units.zh: 壬寅，重修廣壽殿成，有司請以丹漆金碧飾之，帝曰：「此殿經焚，不可不修，但務宏壯，不勞華侈。」
units.en: On renyin the Guangshou Hall was rebuilt; when offices asked for lacquer and gold Mingzong said: "It had been burned and must be restored grandly but not lavishly."
units.literal: On renyin, reconstruction of the Guangshou Hall was finished; the relevant offices asked to adorn it with cinnabar lacquer, gold, and jade; the Emperor said: "This hall was burned and could not go unrepaired, but only seek grandeur—do not trouble with luxury."

units.zh: 湖南奏，敗荊南賊軍於石首鎮。
units.en: Hunan reported defeating Jingnan rebels at Shishou.
units.literal: Hunan memorialized that Jingnan rebel troops were defeated at Shishou garrison.

units.zh: 詔沿邊置場買馬，不許蕃部直至闕下。
units.en: Mingzong ordered border horse markets and barred tribes from coming straight to court.
units.literal: An edict ordered that along the borders horse markets be set up and tribal peoples not be allowed to reach the court directly.

units.zh: 先是，党項諸蕃凡將到馬，無駑良並雲上進，國家雖約其價以給之，及計其館穀錫賚，所費不可勝紀。
units.en: Dangxiang tribes had brought all horses to court for set prices, but lodging and gifts made the cost enormous.
units.literal: Earlier, whenever Dangxiang tribes brought horses, good and poor alike were presented upward; though the state set prices to pay them, counting lodging, grain, and gifts, the expense was beyond reckoning.

units.zh: 計司以為耗蠹中華，遂止之。
units.en: The accounting office called it a drain and ended the practice.
units.literal: The accounting office deemed it a drain on China and therefore stopped it.

units.zh: 壬子，以皇子北京留守、河東節度使從榮為河南尹，判六軍諸衛事；
units.en: On renzi Prince Congrong of Beijing and Hedong became Henan intendant judging the Six Armies;
units.literal: On renzi, the prince, Beijing regent and Hedong military commissioner Congrong, was made Henan intendant, judging the Six Armies and all guards;

units.zh: 以皇子河南尹、判六軍諸衛事從厚為北京留守；
units.en: Prince Conghou of Henan became Beijing regent;
units.literal: the prince, Henan intendant judging the Six Armies and all guards Conghou, was made Beijing regent;

units.zh: 以河陽節度使趙延壽為宋州節度使；
units.en: Zhao Yanshou of Heyang became Song commissioner;
units.literal: Heyang military commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made Song prefecture military commissioner;

units.zh: 以侍衛親軍都指揮使、鎮南軍節度使康義誠為河陽節度使。
units.en: and Kang Yicheng of the palace guard and Zhennan became Heyang commissioner.
units.literal: commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard personal army and Zhennan Army military commissioner Kang Yicheng was made Heyang military commissioner.

units.zh: 契丹寇雲州。
units.en: The Khitan raided Yun.
units.literal: The Khitan raided Yun prefecture.

units.zh: 癸丑，契丹遣捺括梅裏等來朝貢，稱取禿餒等骸骨，並斬於北市。
units.en: On guichou Khitan envoys led by Nako Meri came with tribute claiming to take Tu Nei's bones, and they were beheaded at the north market.
units.literal: On guichou, the Khitan sent Nako Meri and others to court with tribute, claiming to take the bones of Tu Nei and others, who had also been beheaded at the northern market.

units.zh: 甲寅，以端明殿學士趙鳳為門下侍郎兼工部尚書、平章事。
units.en: On jiayin Zhao Feng became secretariat vice director, minister of works, and grand councillor.
units.literal: On jiayin, Duanming Hall academician Zhao Feng was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Works, and Grand Councillor.

units.zh: 丙辰，諫議大夫致仕、襲文宣公孔邈卒。
units.en: Kong Miao, remonstrating censor emeritus and heir to Duke Wenxuan, died.
units.literal: Remonstrating Censor-in-chief emeritus and heir to Duke Wenxuan of Culture Kong Miao died.

units.zh: 庚申，以王建立、孔循帶中書直省吏歸藩，並追回。
units.en: On gengshen Wang Jianli and Kong Xun were recalled for taking secretariat clerks to their circuits.
units.literal: On gengshen, Wang Jianli and Kong Xun taking Secretariat direct-office clerks back to their circuits were both recalled.

units.zh: 壬戌，幽州節度使趙德鈞兼北面行營招討使，鎮州節度使範延光加檢校太傅。
units.en: On renxu Zhao Dejun of Youzhou became northern campaign commissioner and Fan Yanguang of Zhen inspector grand mentor.
units.literal: On renxu, Youzhou military commissioner Zhao Dejun was given added northern campaign headquarters commissioner; Zhen prefecture military commissioner Fan Yanguang was given Inspector Grand Mentor by inspection.

units.zh: 戊辰，中書奏：「五月一日，應在京九品已上官，及諸道進奉使，請準貞元七年敕，就位起居，永為恒式。」
units.en: On wuchen the secretariat asked that on the fifth-month first all capital officials of ninth rank and up and tribute envoys follow the Zhenyuan 7 audience rule permanently."
units.literal: On wuchen, the Secretariat memorialized: "On the first of the fifth month, every official of ninth rank and above who should be in the capital, and envoys presenting tribute from every circuit, should follow the Zhenyuan 7 edict, take position and perform the audience, and make this a constant rule forever."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 五月己巳朔，帝御文明殿受朝。
units.en: On the jisi new moon of the fifth month Mingzong held court at the Wenming Hall.
units.literal: Fifth month, jisi new moon: the Emperor took the Wenming Hall to receive court.

units.zh: 丙子，以夔州節度使西方鄴卒輟朝。
units.en: On bingzi court was canceled for the death of Xi Fangye of Kuizhou.
units.literal: On bingzi, court was suspended because Kuizhou military commissioner Xi Fangye had died.

units.zh: 丁丑，大理卿李保殷卒。
units.en: On dingchou judicial review director Li Baoyin died.
units.literal: On dingchou, Director of the Court of Judicial Review Li Baoyin died.

units.zh: 己卯，以忠武軍節度使索自通為京兆尹，充西京留守；
units.en: On jimao Suo Zitong of Zhongwu became Jingzhao intendant and Western Capital regent;
units.literal: On jimao, Zhongwu Army military commissioner Suo Zitong was made Jingzhao intendant, filling Western Capital regent;

units.zh: 以左威衛上將軍朱漢賓為潞州節度使。
units.en: Zhu Hanbin became Lu commissioner.
units.literal: Left Majestic Guard senior general Zhu Hanbin was made Luzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 乙酉，以黔州節度使安崇阮為夔州節度使，以左驍衛上將軍張溫為洋州節度使，以黔州留後楊漢賓為本州節度使。
units.en: On yiyou An Chongruan moved from Qian to Kuizhou, Zhang Wen became Yang commissioner, and Yang Hanbin full Qian commissioner.
units.literal: On yiyou, Qian prefecture military commissioner An Chongruan was made Kuizhou military commissioner; Left Majestic Cavalry senior general Zhang Wen was made Yang prefecture military commissioner; Qian prefecture acting regent Yang Hanbin was made military commissioner of that prefecture.

units.zh: 中書奏：「太常寺定少帝諡昭宣光烈孝皇帝，廟號景宗。
units.en: The secretariat said: "The sacrifices court had set the Young Emperor's posthumous name Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial and temple name Jing.
units.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices has fixed the Young Emperor's posthumous title Emperor Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial, temple name Emperor Jing.

units.zh: 伏以少帝今不入廟，難以言宗，隻雲昭宣光烈孝皇帝。」
units.en: Since the Young Emperor was not in the temple, it asked to drop the temple name and use only Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial."
units.literal: We submit that since the Young Emperor is not now entered in the temple, it is hard to speak of a temple name—only say Emperor Shaoxuan Guanglie Filial."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 丁亥，以鳳州武興軍留後陳皋為武興軍節度使，以新州威塞軍留後翟璋為威塞軍節度使。
units.en: On dinghai Chen Gao became Wuxing commissioner and Zhai Zhang Weisai commissioner.
units.literal: On dinghai, Feng prefecture Wuxing Army acting regent Chen Gao was made Wuxing Army military commissioner; Xin prefecture Weisai Army acting regent Zhai Zhang was made Weisai Army military commissioner.

units.zh: 壬辰，以權知尚書右丞崔居儉為尚書右丞。
units.en: On renchen Cui Juyin moved from acting to full right secretariat vice director.
units.literal: On renchen, acting Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Cui Juyin was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 詔葺天下廨宇。
units.en: Mingzong ordered government offices repaired empire-wide.
units.literal: An edict ordered repair of government offices throughout the realm.

units.zh: 丙申，襄州奏，荊南高從誨乞歸順。
units.en: On bingshen Xiang reported Gao Conghui of Jingnan sought submission.
units.literal: On bingshen, Xiang prefecture memorialized that Jingnan Gao Conghui begged to submit.

units.zh: 雲州奏，契丹犯塞。
units.en: Yun reported Khitan border raids.
units.literal: Yun prefecture memorialized that the Khitan violated the frontier.

units.zh: 六月辛丑，以左散騎常侍姚顗為兵部侍郎。
units.en: On xinchou in the sixth month Yao Hui became vice war minister.
units.literal: Sixth month, xinchou: Left Regular Cavalier Yao Hui was made Vice Director of the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 壬寅，夔州節度使楊漢章移鎮雲州，以北京馬步軍都指揮使兼欽州刺史張敬達為鳳州節度使。
units.en: On renyin Yang Hanzhang moved from Kuizhou to Yun and Zhang Jingda of Beijing became Feng commissioner.
units.literal: On renyin, Kuizhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was transferred to Yun prefecture; Beijing horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Qin prefecture military commissioner Zhang Jingda was made Feng prefecture military commissioner.

units.zh: 癸卯，以前西京副留守事張遵誨行衛尉事，充客省使。
units.en: On guimao Zhang Zunhui, former Luoyang deputy regent, became chamberlain for dependencies and reception commissioner.
units.literal: On guimao, former Western Capital deputy regent Zhang Zunhui performed the duties of Chamberlain for Dependencies and filled Commissioner of the Reception Bureau.

units.zh: 國子博士田敏請葺四郊祠祭齋室。
units.en: Libationer Tian Min asked to repair the suburban sacrifice fasting halls.
units.literal: National University libationer Tian Min requested repair of the suburban sacrifice fasting chambers.

units.zh: 丙午，以沂州刺史張萬進為安北都護，充振武軍節度使。
units.en: On bingwu Zhang Wanjin of Yi became protector-general pacifying the north and Zhenwu commissioner.
units.literal: On bingwu, Yi prefecture military commissioner Zhang Wanjin was made Protector-General Pacifying the North, filling Zhenwu Army military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊申，以宿州團練使康思立為利州節度使。
units.en: On wushen Kang Sili of Su became Li commissioner.
units.literal: On wushen, Su prefecture training commissioner Kang Sili was made Lizhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 登州刺史孫元停任，坐在任無名科率故也。
units.en: Deng commissioner Sun Yuan was dismissed for unauthorized levies in office.
units.literal: Deng prefecture military commissioner Sun Yuan was removed from office, sitting for unnamed levies while in post.

units.zh: 詔鄴都仍舊為魏府。
units.en: Mingzong restored Yedu's old name Weifu.
units.literal: An edict restored Yedu to its former name as Weifu.

units.zh: 應魏府、汴州、益州宮殿悉去鴟尾，賜節度使為衙署。
units.en: Roof ornaments were stripped from palaces at Weifu, Bian, and Yi and given to commissioners as offices.
units.literal: At Weifu, Bian prefecture, and Yizhou all palace roof ornaments were removed and given to military commissioners as yamen offices.

units.zh: 辛亥，以權知朔方軍留後、定難軍都知兵馬使韓澄為朔方留後。
units.en: On xinhai Han Cheng became Shuofang acting regent.
units.literal: On xinhai, acting regent of the Shuofang Army and Dingnan Army commander-in-chief Han Cheng was made Shuofang acting regent.

units.zh: 癸丑，以前潞州節度使符彥超為左驍衛上將軍。
units.en: On guichou Fu Yanchao became left majestic cavalry senior general.
units.literal: On guichou, former Luzhou military commissioner Fu Yanchao was made Left Majestic Cavalry senior general.

units.zh: 詔：「諸道節度使行軍司馬，名位雖高，或帥臣不在，其州事宜委節度副使權知。」
units.en: Mingzong ordered: "When a commissioner was away the vice commissioner should run circuit affairs."
units.literal: An edict said: "Every circuit military commissioner's campaign adjutant, though high in name, if the commander is absent the prefectural affairs of that circuit should be entrusted to the military vice commissioner to act."

units.zh: 又詔：「藩郡所請賓幕及主事親從者，悉以名聞。」
units.en: Another edict required: "Fief circuits must report all staff and followers by name."
units.literal: Another edict said: "For every fief circuit, all staff and chief clerks and personal followers requested should be reported by name."

units.zh: 丙辰，權知荊南軍府事高從誨上章首罪，乞修職貢，仍進銀三千兩贖罪。
units.en: On bingchen Gao Conghui confessed guilt, offered to resume tribute, and sent three thousand taels of silver in atonement.
units.literal: On bingchen, acting regent of Jingnan military headquarters Gao Conghui submitted a memorial confessing guilt, begging to restore tribute duties, and still presenting three thousand taels of silver to redeem guilt.

units.zh: 壬戌，幸至德宮。
units.en: On renxu Mingzong visited the Zhide Palace.
units.literal: On renxu, the Emperor visited the Zhide Palace.

units.zh: 詔：「京城空地，課人蓋造。
units.en: Mingzong ordered: "Vacant capital land would be taxed for people to build on.
units.literal: An edict said: "Vacant land in the capital is to be taxed for people to build on.

units.zh: 如無力者，許人請射營構。」
units.en: The poor could let others bid and build for them."
units.literal: Those without means may request others to bid and construct."

units.zh: 秋七月庚午，以前西京留守判官張鎛為司農卿。
units.en: On gengwu in the seventh month Zhang Bo, former Luoyang regent's aide, became imperial granaries director.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu: former Western Capital regent's aide Zhang Bo was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Granaries.

units.zh: 壬申，貶前左金吾上將軍毛璋為儒州長流百姓，尋賜自盡，以其在藩鎮陰蓄奸謀故也。
units.en: On renshen Mao Zhang was exiled to Ru as a commoner and soon ordered to kill himself for plotting treason in his circuit.
units.literal: On renshen, former Left Gold Spears senior general Mao Zhang was demoted to commoner exiled to Ru prefecture; soon he was granted suicide, because while in a fief circuit he had secretly harbored treacherous designs.

units.zh: 甲戌，御史中丞呂夢奇責授太子右讚善大夫，坐曾借毛璋馬故也。
units.en: On jiaxu Lü Mengqi was demoted to crown prince praise officer for borrowing Mao Zhang's horse.
units.literal: On jiaxu, Censor-in-chief Lü Mengqi was demoted to Crown Prince Right Praise Officer, sitting for having once borrowed Mao Zhang's horse.

units.zh: 己卯，以工部侍郎任讚為左散騎常侍，以樞密直學士、左諫議大夫、充匭使閻至為工部侍郎充職。
units.en: On jimao Ren Zan became left regular cavalier and Yan Zhi minister of works.
units.literal: On jimao, Minister of Works Ren Zan was made Left Regular Cavalier; Privy Council academician, Left Remonstrator, and Pouch commissioner Yan Zhi was made Minister of Works filling the post.

units.zh: 遂州進嘉禾，一莖九穗。
units.en: Suizhou presented auspicious grain with nine ears on one stalk.
units.literal: Suizhou presented auspicious grain, one stalk with nine ears.

units.zh: 壬午，以給事中、判大理卿事許光義為御史中丞。
units.en: On renwu Xu Guangyi became censor-in-chief.
units.literal: On renwu, Attendant-in-Chief and acting Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xu Guangyi was made Censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 史館上言：「所編修莊宗一朝事跡，欲名為實錄，太祖、獻祖、懿祖名為紀年錄。」
units.en: The historiography office asked to title Zhuangzong's reign Veritable Records and the three ancestors Chronological Records."
units.literal: The Historiography Office memorialized: "The events of the Zhuangzong reign now being compiled are wished to be titled Veritable Records; the Founding Ancestor, Offering Ancestor, and Honored Ancestor are wished to be titled Chronological Records."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：天成三年十二月，史館奏：「據左補闕張昭遠狀：『嘗讀國書，伏見懿祖昭烈皇帝自元和之初，獻祖文皇帝於太和之際，立功王室，陳力國朝。
units.en: (The Five Dynasties Essentials says in the twelfth month of Tiancheng 3 the historiography office cited Zhang Zhaoyuan: "Having read the state histories, I found the honored and offering ancestors had served the Tang from Yuanhe and Taihe onward.
units.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Twelfth month of Tiancheng 3, the Historiography Office memorialized: "According to the memorial of Left Remonstrator Zhang Zhaoyuan: 'Having read the state histories, I see the Honored Ancestor Illustrious Emperor from the beginning of Yuanhe, the Offering Ancestor Cultured Emperor in the Taihe period, both serving the royal house and exerting strength for the dynasty.

units.zh: 太祖武皇帝自咸通後來，勤王戮力，翦平多難，頻立大功，三換節旄，再安京國。
units.en: The founding martial emperor after Xiantong had repeatedly saved the capital and won great merit with three commission changes.
units.literal: The Founding Martial Emperor from after Xiantong came repeatedly to aid the throne and cut down many difficulties, often establishing great merit, thrice changing his commission, twice securing the capital.

units.zh: 莊宗皇帝終平大憝，奄有中原，倘闕編修，遂成湮墜。
units.en: Zhuangzong had pacified the realm; without compilation their deeds would be lost.
units.literal: Emperor Zhuangzong finally pacified the great enemy and suddenly held the Central Plains; if compilation is lacking, it will sink into oblivion.

units.zh: 伏請與當館修撰，參序條綱，撰太祖、莊宗實錄者。』」
units.en: He asked to compile Veritable Records of the founding ancestor and Zhuangzong with the office."』」
units.literal: I beg to compile with the office's editors in ordered outline the Veritable Records of the Founding Ancestor and Zhuangzong."』」

units.zh: 四年七月，監修國史趙鳳奏：「奉敕修懿祖、獻祖、太祖、莊宗四帝實錄，自今年六月一日起手，旋具進呈。
units.en: In the seventh month of year 4, Zhao Feng, supervising compiler of state history, reported: "By edict we are compiling the Veritable Records of the four emperors Yizu, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong, beginning on the first day of the sixth month of this year and to be presented as they are completed.
units.literal: Seventh month, year 4, supervising compiler of state history Zhao Feng memorialized: "By edict we compile the Veritable Records of the Honored, Offering, Founding, and Zhuangzong emperors, beginning this sixth month and soon to present them.

units.zh: 伏以凡關纂述，務合品題。
units.en: Titles had to fit each subject.
units.literal: We submit that in every compilation the titles must fit the subjects.

units.zh: 承乾禦宇之君，行事方雲實錄；
units.en: Reigning emperors' acts were Veritable Records;
units.literal: For rulers who took the throne in their own right, their acts are properly called Veritable Records;

units.zh: 追尊冊號之帝，約文隻可紀年。
units.en: posthumously titled ancestors could only be Chronological Records.
units.literal: for emperors posthumously honored with temple names, the text may only be Chronological Records.

units.zh: 所修前件史書，今欲自莊宗一朝名為實錄，其太祖以上並目為紀年錄。」
units.en: Zhao Feng proposed Zhuangzong alone as Veritable Records and the founding ancestor and above as Chronological Records."
units.literal: For the histories compiled above, it is now wished that the Zhuangzong reign alone be named Veritable Records, and all from the Founding Ancestor upward be titled Chronological Records."

units.zh: 從之。）〉
units.en: Approved.)〉
units.literal: It was approved.)〉

units.zh: 甲申，以前荊南行軍司馬、檢校太傅高從誨起復，授檢校太傅、兼侍中，充荊南節度使。
units.en: On jiashen Gao Conghui—former Jingnan campaign marshal and honorary grand preceptor—was recalled and made honorary grand preceptor, palace attendant, and Jingnan commissioner.
units.literal: On jiashen, former Jingnan campaign marshal and honorary Grand Preceptor Gao Conghui was recalled to service and made honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Palace Attendant, and Jingnan military commissioner.

units.zh: 丙戌，涇州節度使李從昶移鎮華州，以冀州刺史李金全為涇州節度使。
units.en: On bingxu Li Congchang of Jing moved to Hua and Li Jinquan of Ji became Jing commissioner.
units.literal: On bingxu, Jing military commissioner Li Congchang was transferred to Hua; Jizhou prefect Li Jinquan was made Jing military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊子，中書奏：「今後新及第舉人，有曾授正官及禦署者，欲約前任資序，與除一官。」
units.en: The Secretariat said: "New jinshi who had held regular office or imperial secretariat posts should receive one further office by prior rank and seniority."
units.literal: The Central Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter among newly passed jinshi, those who had formerly held regular office or imperial secretariat posts should, in accord with prior rank and seniority, receive one additional office."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 壬辰，詔取來年二月二十一日有事於南郊。
units.en: On renchen Mingzong set the southern suburban rites for the twenty-first of the second month of next year.
units.literal: On renchen an edict set the southern suburban rites for the twenty-first of the second month of next year.

units.zh: 八月丁酉朔，大理正路阮奏：「切見春秋釋奠於文宣王，而武成王廟久曠時祭，請復常祀。」
units.en: On dingyou in the eighth month Lu Ruan, grand court corrector, said: "Spring and autumn sacrifices reach Confucius, yet the Martial Completion King has long lacked regular rites; I ask that worship be restored."
units.literal: Eighth month, dingyou: Grand Court Corrector Lu Ruan memorialized: "I observe that in spring and autumn the libation to Confucius is performed, yet the temple of the Martial Completion King has long lacked regular sacrifice; I ask that regular worship be restored."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 戊戌，中書奏：「太子少傅李琪所撰進《霍彥威神道碑》文，不分真偽，是混功名，望令改撰。」
units.en: On wuxu the Secretariat said: "Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi's spirit-way stele for Huo Yanwei confounds true and false and merit and name; we ask that it be rewritten."
units.literal: On wuxu the Central Secretariat memorialized: "The spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei submitted by Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Qi does not distinguish true from false and confounds merit and name; we ask that it be rewritten."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 琪，梁之故相，私懷感遇，敘彥威在梁曆任，不欲言偽梁故也。
units.en: Qi had been a Liang chancellor who cherished old favor and, narrating Yanwei's Liang service, avoided naming false Liang—hence the fault.
units.literal: Qi was a former Liang chancellor who privately cherished gratitude for favor and in narrating Yanwei's Liang service did not wish to speak of false Liang—hence this.

units.zh: 辛丑，詔：「亂離已來，天下諸軍所掠生口，有主識認，即勒還之。」
units.en: On xinchou an edict said: "Since the turmoil, captives taken by armies under Heaven, when owners can be identified, must be returned."
units.literal: On xinchou an edict said: "Since the age of turmoil, among captives seized by armies under Heaven, where owners can be identified they are to be compelled to return them."

units.zh: 以前清河縣令、襲酅國公、食邑三千戶楊仁矩為秘書丞。
units.en: Yang Renju, former magistrate of Qinghe and Duke of E with three thousand fief households, became Secretariat aide.
units.literal: Former Qinghe county magistrate Yang Renju, enfeoffed Duke of E with a fief of three thousand households, was made Secretariat aide.

units.zh: 御史台奏：「主簿朱穎是前中丞奏請，合隨聽罷任。」
units.en: The Censorate said: "Registrar Zhu Ying had been the former censor-in-chief's appointee and should leave when his patron did."
units.literal: The Censorate memorialized: "Registrar Zhu Ying was requested by the former censor-in-chief and should leave office with his patron."

units.zh: 詔曰：「主簿既為正秩，況入選門，顯自朝恩，合終考限，宜令仍舊守官。」
units.en: An edict said: "The registrar already held regular rank and had entered by selection; the appointment was plainly from court and he should finish his term—let him remain."
units.literal: An edict said: "The registrar already holds regular rank and moreover entered through the selection gate; the favor was plainly from court and he should complete his review term—let him remain in office."

units.zh: 甲辰，以宰臣馮道為南郊大禮使，兵部尚書盧質為禮儀使，御史中丞許光義為儀仗使，兵部侍郎姚顗為鹵簿使，河南尹從榮為橋道頓遞使，客省使、衛尉卿張遵誨為修裝法物使。
units.en: On jiachen Feng Dao became southern suburban chief ritualist; Lu Zhi of War, ritualist; Xu Guangyi, censor-in-chief, equipage master; Yao Yi of War, halberd master; Congrong of Henan, bridge and relay master; Zhang Zunhui, guest commissioner and Court of the Imperial Clan director, repair and regalia master.
units.literal: On jiachen Chancellor Feng Dao was made southern suburban chief ritualist; Minister of War Lu Zhi ritualist; Censor-in-Chief Xu Guangyi equipage master; Vice Minister of War Yao Yan halberd master; Henan prefect Congrong bridge and relay master; Guest Bureau commissioner and Director of the Court for the Imperial Clan Zhang Zunhui repair and regalia master.

units.zh: 乙巳，黑水朝貢使郭濟等率屬來朝，授歸德司戈，放還蕃。
units.en: On yisi Guo Ji of Black River and others led their tribes to court, were made Returned Virtue company commanders, and were sent home.
units.literal: On yisi Black River tribute envoy Guo Ji and others led their tribes to court; they were made Returned Virtue company commanders and sent back to their tribes.

units.zh: 丁未，以翰林學士承旨、禮部侍郎、知制誥李愚為兵部侍郎，職如故。
units.en: On dingwei Li Yu—Hanlin exequatur, vice minister of rites, and edict drafter—became vice minister of war at rank.
units.literal: On dingwei Hanlin academician exequatur, Vice Minister of Rites, and edict drafter Li Yu was made Vice Minister of War at his post.

units.zh: 以中書舍人盧詹為禮部侍郎，以兵部侍郎裴皞為太子賓客。
units.en: Lu Zhan became vice minister of rites; Pei Hao of War became crown prince mentor.
units.literal: Secretariat drafting officer Lu Zhan was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of War Pei Hao was made crown prince mentor.

units.zh: 吐渾首領念公山來朝貢。
units.en: Tuyuhun chieftain Nian Gongshan presented tribute at court.
units.literal: Tuyuhun chieftain Nian Gongshan came to court with tribute.

units.zh: 戊申，帝服袞冕，禦文明殿，追冊昭宣光烈孝皇帝。
units.en: On wushen Mingzong in full regalia held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to posthumously ennoble Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao.
units.literal: On wushen the Emperor wore full regalia and held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to posthumously ennoble Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao.

units.zh: 庚戌，以宰臣、監修國史趙鳳兼判集賢院事，以左散騎常侍任讚判大理卿事。
units.en: On gengxu Zhao Feng—chancellor and supervising historiographer—also directed the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Ren Zan, left regular attendant, judged Court of Judicial Review affairs.
units.literal: On gengxu Chancellor and supervising historiographer Zhao Feng was made concurrent Director of the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Left Regular Attendant Ren Zan judged Director of the Court of Judicial Review affairs.

units.zh: 己未，高麗王王建遣使貢方物。
units.en: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys with local tribute.
units.literal: On jiwei King Jian of Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products.

units.zh: 辛酉，詔：「準往例，節度使帶平章事、侍中、中書令，並列銜於敕牒，側書『使』字。
units.en: An edict said: "By precedent, commissioners with concurrent grand councilor, palace attendant, or secretariat director titles listed them on edict slips with 'commissioner' written to the side.
units.literal: An edict said: "By former precedent, military commissioners bearing concurrent Grand Councilor, Palace Attendant, or Secretariat Director titles all listed those titles on edict slips with the character 'commissioner' written to the side.

units.zh: 今錢鏐是元帥、尚父，與使相名殊，馬殷守太師、尚書令，是南省官資，不合署敕尾，今後敕牒內並落下。」
units.en: Qian Liu is marshal-in-chief and imperial father, unlike commissioners; Ma Yin holds grand preceptor and master of writing, a southern rank unfit for edict tails—hereafter omit both from edict slips."
units.literal: Now Qian Liu is Marshal-in-Chief and Imperial Father, a title unlike commissioners; Ma Yin holds Grand Preceptor and Master of Writing, a southern-department rank unfit for signing edict tails—hereafter let both be omitted from edict slips."

units.zh: 乙卯，党項首領朝貢。
units.en: On yimao Tangut chieftains presented tribute.
units.literal: On yimao Tangut chieftains presented tribute.

units.zh: 甲子，幸金真觀，改賜建法大師，賜紫尼智願為圓惠大師，即武皇夫人陳氏也。
units.en: On jiazi Mingzong visited Golden Truth Abbey, changed the bestowed title to Great Master Jianfa, and bestowed purple on the nun Zhiyuan as Great Master Yuanhui—Lady Chen, consort of Martial Emperor.
units.literal: On jiazi the Emperor visited the Golden Truth Abbey, changed the bestowed title to Great Master Jianfa, and bestowed purple on the nun Zhiyuan as Great Master Yuanhui—she was Lady Chen, consort of Martial Emperor.

units.zh: 丙寅，達靼來朝貢。
units.en: On bingyin the Dadan presented tribute at court.
units.literal: On bingyin the Dadan came to court with tribute.

units.zh: 京城內有南州、北州，乃張全義光啟中所築。
units.en: The capital held Southern and Northern wards that Zhang Quanyi had built in the Guangqi era.
units.literal: Within the capital were Southern and Northern Wards, built by Zhang Quanyi in the Guangqi era.

units.zh: 至是，詔許人依街巷請射城濠，任使平填，蓋造屋宇。
units.en: An edict then allowed people to bid by ward and lane to fill the moat and build houses freely.
units.literal: At this time an edict allowed people to bid by ward and lane to fill the moat and build houses as they wished.

units.zh: 九月丁卯，中書奏：「據宗正寺申，懿祖永興陵、獻祖長寧陵、太祖建極陵並在代州雁門縣，皇帝追尊四廟在應州金城縣。」
units.en: On dingmao in the ninth month the Secretariat said: "The Imperial Clan Court reports Illustrious Ancestor Yongxing, Exalted Ancestor Changning, and Martial Ancestor Establishing the Utmost in Yanmen, Dai, while the four posthumous temples stand in Jincheng, Ying."
units.literal: Ninth month, dingmao: the Central Secretariat memorialized: "According to the Imperial Clan Court, the tombs of Illustrious Ancestor Yongxing, Exalted Ancestor Changning, and Martial Ancestor Establishing the Utmost all lie in Yanmen county, Dai prefecture; the Emperor's four posthumous temples lie in Jincheng county, Ying prefecture."

units.zh: 詔：「應州升為望州，金城、雁門並升為望縣。」
units.en: An edict said: "Raise Ying to a superior prefecture and Jincheng and Yanmen to superior counties."
units.literal: An edict said: "Ying prefecture is raised to a superior prefecture; Jincheng and Yanmen are each raised to superior counties."

units.zh: 辛酉，太常博士段顒奏：「切見大祠則差宰相行事，中祠則卿監行事，小祠則委太祝、奉禮，並不差官，今後請差五品官行事。」
units.en: On xinyou Duan Yan of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "Great sacrifices send a chancellor, middle ones a director or supervisor, and small ones leave the grand invoker or ceremonial attendant without an envoy; hereafter let fifth-rank officials perform the rite."
units.literal: On xinyou Court of Imperial Sacrifices academician Duan Yan memorialized: "I observe that for great sacrifices a chancellor is dispatched to perform the rite, for middle sacrifices a director or supervisor, and for small sacrifices the Grand Invoker or Ceremonial Attendant is entrusted without dispatching an official; hereafter let fifth-rank officials perform the rite."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 癸巳，製天下兵馬元帥、尚父、吳越國王錢鏐可落元帥、尚父、吳越國王，授太師致仕，責無禮也。
units.en: On guisi Mingzong stripped Qian Liu of Wu-Yue of marshal, imperial father, and king and made him retired grand preceptor—for lack of ritual.
units.literal: On guisi an edict stripped All-Armies Marshal-in-Chief, Imperial Father, and King of Wu-Yue Qian Liu of marshal, imperial father, and king of Wu-Yue and made him Grand Preceptor in retirement—for lack of ritual.

units.zh: 先是，上將軍烏昭遇使於兩浙，以朝廷事私於吳人，仍目鏐為殿下，自稱臣，謁鏐行拜蹈之禮。
units.en: Earlier Senior General Wu Zhaoyu had gone to the two Zhes, divulged court affairs to Wu men, called Liu "Your Highness" and himself "your subject," and bowed and prostrated on meeting him.
units.literal: Earlier, Senior General Wu Zhaoyu had been envoy to the two Zhes and divulged court affairs to the Wu men, also calling Liu "Your Highness" and himself "your subject," performing bowing and prostration when he met Liu.

units.zh: 及回，使副劉玫具述其事，故停削鏐官爵，令致仕。
units.en: Deputy envoy Liu Mei reported it fully on return; Liu's titles were cut and he was ordered to retire.
units.literal: On his return deputy envoy Liu Mei fully reported the matter; hence Liu's titles were suspended and he was ordered to retire.

units.zh: 烏昭遇下御史台，尋賜自盡。
units.en: Wu Zhaoyu went to the Censorate and soon was ordered to kill himself.
units.literal: Wu Zhaoyu was sent to the Censorate and soon ordered to kill himself.

units.zh: 後有自浙中使還者，言昭遇無臣鏐之事，為玫所誣，人頗以為冤。
units.en: Later an envoy from Zhe said Zhaoyu had never treated Liu as sovereign and Mei had framed him; many thought it unjust.
units.literal: Later an envoy returning from Zhe said Zhaoyu had never treated Liu as sovereign and that Mei had framed him; many thought it a grievous injustice.

units.zh: 乙未，詔諸道通勘兩浙綱運進奉使，並下巡獄。
units.en: On yiwei an edict ordered every circuit to investigate and arrest two-Zhe tribute envoys.
units.literal: On yiwei an edict ordered every circuit to investigate and arrest envoys of the two Zhes who presented tribute.

units.zh: 冬十月丙申朔，並吏部三銓為一銓，宜令本司官員同商量注擬，連署申奏，仍不得於私第注官。
units.en: On bingshen in the tenth month of winter the three Personnel Bureaus merged into one; its officers were to deliberate nominations jointly, countersign memorials, and not assign posts from private homes.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingshen: the three Personnel Bureaus were merged into one; officials of this office should jointly deliberate nominations, countersign memorials, and must not assign offices from private residences.

units.zh: 戊戌，以襄州兵馬都監、守磁州刺史康福為朔方、河西等節度使，靈、威、雄、警、涼等州觀察使。
units.en: On wuxu Kang Fu—Xiang army supervisor and acting Ci prefect—became Shuofang and Hexi commissioner and observer of Ling, Wei, Xiong, Jing, and Liang.
units.literal: On wuxu Xiangzhou army supervisor and acting Ci prefect Kang Fu was made military commissioner of Shuofang, Hexi, and the rest, and observation commissioner of Ling, Wei, Xiong, Jing, and Liang.

units.zh: 時朔方將吏請帥於朝廷，故命福往鎮之。
units.en: Shuofang officers had asked court for a commander; hence Fu was sent to take the post.
units.literal: At the time Shuofang officers and clerks asked the court for a commander; hence Fu was ordered to take the post.

units.zh: 庚子，以右金吾上將軍史敬鎔為左金吾上將軍，以左驍衛上將軍符彥超為右金吾上將軍，以前黔州節度使李承約為右驍衛上將軍，以雲州節度使張敬詢為左驍衛上將軍，以前華州節度使王景戡為右驍衛上將軍。
units.en: On gengzi Shi Jingrong became left golden guard senior general; Fu Yanchao, left martial cavalry senior general, right golden guard senior general; Li Chengyue, former Qian commissioner, right martial cavalry senior general; Zhang Jingxun of Yun, left martial cavalry senior general; Wang Jingzhan, former Hua commissioner, right martial cavalry senior general.
units.literal: On gengzi Right Golden Guard senior general Shi Jingrong was made Left Golden Guard senior general; Left Martial Cavalry senior general Fu Yanchao was made Right Golden Guard senior general; former Qian military commissioner Li Chengyue was made Right Martial Cavalry senior general; Yun military commissioner Zhang Jingxun was made Left Martial Cavalry senior general; former Hua military commissioner Wang Jingzhan was made Right Martial Cavalry senior general.

units.zh: 癸卯，太常少卿蕭願責授太子洗馬，奪緋。
units.en: On guimao Xiao Yuan, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was demoted to crown prince groom and stripped of crimson.
units.literal: On guimao Court of Imperial Sacrifices vice director Xiao Yuan was demoted to crown prince groom and stripped of crimson.

units.zh: 願南郊行事，與祠官同飲，詰旦猶醉不能行禮，為御史所劾也。
units.en: At the southern suburban rites Yuan drank with the ritual officers and at dawn was still too drunk to perform—the censorate impeached him.
units.literal: At the southern suburban rites Yuan drank with the ritual officers; at dawn he was still drunk and could not perform the rites—the censorate impeached him.

units.zh: 詔新授朔方節度使康福將兵萬人赴鎮。
units.en: An edict ordered newly appointed Shuofang commissioner Kang Fu to march ten thousand troops to his post.
units.literal: An edict ordered newly appointed Shuofang military commissioner Kang Fu to lead ten thousand troops to his post.

units.zh: 己酉，製復故荊南節度使高季興官爵。
units.en: On jiyou Mingzong restored former Jingnan commissioner Gao Jixing's office and rank.
units.literal: On jiyou an edict restored former Jingnan military commissioner Gao Jixing's office and rank.

units.zh: 辛亥，升閬州為保寧軍。
units.en: On xinhai Lang was raised to Baoning Army.
units.literal: On xinhai Lang prefecture was raised to Baoning Army.

units.zh: 壬子，以內客省使、左衛大將軍李仁矩為閬州節度使。
units.en: On renzi Li Renju—inner guest commissioner and left guard senior general—became Lang commissioner.
units.literal: On renzi Inner Guest Bureau commissioner and Left Guard senior general Li Renju was made Lang military commissioner.

units.zh: 幸七星亭。
units.en: Mingzong visited the Seven Stars Pavilion.
units.literal: The Emperor visited the Seven Stars Pavilion.

units.zh: 丙辰，夏州進白鷹，重誨奏曰：「夏州違詔進貢，臣已止約。」
units.en: On bingchen Xia presented a white hawk; Chonghui said: "Xia has violated the edict with tribute; I have already stopped it."
units.literal: On bingchen Xia presented a white hawk; Chonghui memorialized: "Xia has presented tribute in violation of the edict; your servant has already stopped it."

units.zh: 帝曰：「善。」
units.en: Mingzong said: "Good."
units.literal: The Emperor said: "Good."

units.zh: 朝退，帝密令左右進焉。
units.en: After court he secretly ordered attendants to bring it in.
units.literal: After court was dismissed the Emperor secretly ordered attendants to present it.

units.zh: 是日，幸龍門。
units.en: That day Mingzong visited Longmen.
units.literal: That day the Emperor visited Longmen.

units.zh: 十一月丁卯，洛州水暴漲，壞居人垣舍。
units.en: On dingmao in the eleventh month Lu waters rose violently and destroyed dwellings.
units.literal: Eleventh month, dingmao: Luozhou waters rose violently and destroyed people's walls and houses.

units.zh: 戊辰，以刑部侍郎張文寶為右散騎常侍。
units.en: On wuchen Zhang Wenbao of Punishments became right regular attendant.
units.literal: On wuchen Vice Minister of Punishments Zhang Wenbao was made Right Regular Attendant.

units.zh: 己巳，以尚書右丞李光序為刑部侍郎。
units.en: On jisi Li Guangxu, right vice director, became vice minister of punishments.
units.literal: On jisi Right Vice Director Li Guangxu was made Vice Minister of Punishments.

units.zh: 癸酉，升曹州濟陰縣為次赤，以昭宣光烈孝皇帝溫陵所在故也。
units.en: On guiyou Jiyin of Cao was raised to second-tier red as the site of Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao's Warm Tomb.
units.literal: On guiyou Jiyin county of Caozhou was raised to second-tier red because it was the site of Emperor Zhaoxuan Guanglie Xiao's Warm Tomb.

units.zh: 甲戌，奉國軍節度使王延稟加兼侍中，從福建節度使王延鈞請也。
units.en: On jiaxu Wang Yanbin of Fengguo gained concurrent palace attendant at Wang Yanjun of Fujian's request.
units.literal: On jiaxu Fengguo Army military commissioner Wang Yanbin gained concurrent Palace Attendant at Fujian military commissioner Wang Yanjun's request.

units.zh: 車駕出近郊，試夏州所進白鷹，戒左右勿令重誨知。
units.en: Mingzong went to the near suburbs to fly Xia's white hawk, warning attendants to keep it from Chonghui.
units.literal: The imperial carriage went to the near suburbs to try the white hawk Xia had presented, warning attendants not to let Chonghui know.

units.zh: 己卯，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀。
units.en: On jimao, the winter solstice, Mingzong held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor for congratulation.
units.literal: On jimao, the winter solstice, the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulation.

units.zh: 癸未，秘書少監於嶠配振武長流百姓，永不齒任，為宰臣趙鳳誣奏也。
units.en: On guiwei Yu Qiao, secretariat vice director, was sentenced to long exile as a commoner at Zhenwu and barred from office forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.
units.literal: On guiwei Secretariat vice director Yu Qiao was matched to a long-exiled commoner of Zhenwu and barred from office forever—Zhao Feng's false memorial.

units.zh: 史官張昭遠等以新修獻祖、懿祖、太祖《紀年錄》共二十卷、《莊宗實錄》三十卷上之，賜器帛有差。
units.en: Historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the new 《Chronicle Records》 of the exalted and illustrious and martial ancestors in twenty juan and the 《Veritable Record》 of Zhuangzong in thirty juan; vessels and silks were graded by rank.
units.literal: Historiographers Zhang Zhaoyuan and others presented the newly compiled 《Chronicle Records》 of Exalted and Illustrious Ancestors and Martial Ancestor in twenty juan and the 《Veritable Record》 of Emperor Zhuangzong in thirty juan; vessels and silks were bestowed in graded amounts.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：監修趙鳳、修撰張昭遠、呂咸休各賜繒彩、銀器等。）〉
units.en: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》 says supervising compiler Zhao Feng and compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)
units.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: Supervising compiler Zhao Feng, compilers Zhang Zhaoyuan and Lü Xianxiu each received silks, silver vessels, and the like.)

units.zh: 十二月丁酉，靈武康福奏：「破野利、大蟲兩族三百餘帳於方渠，獲牛羊三萬。」
units.en: On dingyou in the twelfth month Kang Fu of Lingwu reported: "We routed the Yeli and Dachong—more than three hundred households—at Fangqu and took thirty thousand cattle and sheep."
units.literal: Twelfth month, dingyou: Lingwu's Kang Fu memorialized: "We routed the Yeli and Dachong tribes—more than three hundred households—at Fangqu and took thirty thousand head of cattle and sheep."

units.zh: 戊戌，詔：「應授官及封贈官誥、舉人冬集等所費用物，一切官破。」
units.en: On wuxu an edict said: "All costs for appointment and enfeoffment patents and candidates' winter gathering shall be borne by the state."
units.literal: On wuxu an edict said: "All costs for appointment patents, enfeoffment patents, and winter gathering of examination candidates shall be borne entirely by the state."

units.zh: 壬戌，中書奏：「今後宰臣致齋內，不押班，不知印，不赴內殿起居。
units.en: On renxu the Secretariat said: "While chancellors abstain for rites within the palace they shall not lead court procession, hold the seal, or attend inner levee.
units.literal: On renxu the Central Secretariat memorialized: "Hereafter while chancellors are in ritual abstinence within the palace they shall not lead the court procession, hold the seal, or attend inner-palace levee.

units.zh: 或遇國忌，行事官已受誓戒，宜不赴行香，並不奏刑殺公事。
units.en: On state mourning days, ritual officers already sworn should not attend incense, and capital cases should not be memorialized.
units.literal: When a state mourning day occurs, if the ritual officer has already taken the oath he should not attend incense offering, and capital punishment matters should not be memorialized.

units.zh: 大祠致齋內，請不開宴。
units.en: During great-sacrifice abstinence, banquets should not be held.
units.literal: During great-sacrifice abstinence, banquets should not be held.

units.zh: 每遇大忌前一日，請不坐朝。」
units.en: On the day before each great mourning day, court should not sit."
units.literal: On the day before each great mourning day, court should not sit."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 庚午，以權知北京軍府事、汾州刺史符彥超為晉州留後，以前陳州刺史劉伸殷為陝州留後。
units.en: On gengwu, Fu Yanchao, acting administrator of the Northern Capital Military Prefecture and prefect of Fenzhou, was made acting military commissioner of Jinzhou; Liu Shenyin, former prefect of Chenzhou, was made acting military commissioner of Shanzhou.
units.literal: On gengwu, acting Beiping military commissioner and Fenzhou prefect Fu Yanchao was made Jinzhou acting military commissioner; former Chenzhou prefect Liu Shenyin was made Shanzhou acting military commissioner.

units.zh: 甲寅，以晉州留後符彥超為北京留守，以鎮州副使王建立為鎮州留後，以右龍武統軍安崇阮為晉州留後。
units.en: On jiayin Fu Yanchao became Beijing regent; Wang Jianli became Zhen acting commissioner; An Chongruan became Jin acting commissioner.
units.literal: On jiayin, Jin acting commissioner Fu Yanchao was made Beijing regent; Zhenzhou deputy Wang Jianli was made Zhen acting commissioner; Right Dragon Martial commander An Chongruan was made Jin acting commissioner.

units.zh: 庚辰，奉國軍節度使兼威武軍節度副使、檢校太尉、兼侍中王延稟加兼中書令。
units.en: On gengchen Wang Yanbin, military governor of Fengguo Army, concurrently deputy military governor of Weiwu Army, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrently Palace Attendant, was additionally made Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On gengchen, Fengguo Army military commissioner and concurrent Weiwu Army deputy military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and Palace Attendant Wang Yanbin gained concurrent Secretariat director.

units.zh: 秋七月甲子，以宣徽南院使、行右衛上將軍、判三司馮贇為北京留守、太原尹。
units.en: On jiazi in the seventh month Feng Yun—southern secretariat commissioner, acting right guard general, and three bureaus director—became Beijing regent and Taiyuan prefect.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiazi: Palace Secretariat southern commissioner, acting Right Guard senior general, and Director of the Three Bureaus Feng Yun was made Beijing regent and Taiyuan prefect.

units.zh: 以汝州防禦使趙延壽為河陽節度使，以比部郎中、知制誥劉讚為中書舍人，以河陽掌書記程遜為比部員外郎、知制誥，以代州刺史李德充為蔚州刺史。
units.en: Zhao Yanshou, Ru defense commissioner, became Heyang commissioner; Liu Zan, Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter, became Secretariat drafting officer; Cheng Xun, Heyang secretary, became Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Li Dechong of Dai became Yu prefect.
units.literal: Ruzhou defense commissioner Zhao Yanshou was made Heyang military commissioner; Bureau of Revenue director and edict drafter Liu Zan was made Secretariat drafting officer; Heyang secretary Cheng Xun was made Bureau of Revenue vice director and edict drafter; Dai prefect Li Dechong was made Yu prefect.

units.zh: 以翰林承旨、兵部尚書、知制誥盧質為檢校司空，充同州節度使。
units.en: Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting Minister of Works and Tong commissioner.
units.literal: Hanlin edict-drafter, Minister of War, and edict drafter Lu Zhi was made acting Grand Preceptor and Tongzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 丙午，以荊南節度使、守中書令、渤海王高季興依前檢校太師、兼尚書令，封南平王；
units.en: On bingwu Gao Jixing of Jingnan kept acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Imperial Secretariat and was made Prince of Nanping;
units.literal: On bingwu, Jingnan military commissioner, acting Secretariat Director, and Prince of Bohai Gao Jixing remained acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;

units.zh: 庚午，應州節度使張敬達移雲州，以捧聖都指揮使、守恩州刺史沙彥詢為應州節度使；
units.en: On gengwu Zhang Jingda, military governor of Yingzhou, was transferred to Yunzhou; Sha Yanxun, Pingsheng overall commander and acting prefect of Enzhou, became military governor of Yingzhou;
units.literal: On gengwu Ying military commissioner Zhang Jingda was transferred to Yun; Protector Saint commander and En prefect Sha Yanxun was made Ying military commissioner;

units.zh: 以中書舍人劉讚為御史中丞，以御史中丞許光義為兵部侍即，以兵部侍郎姚顗為吏部侍郎。
units.en: Liu Zan became censor-in-chief; Xu Guangyi became vice war minister; Yao Yi became vice personnel minister.
units.literal: Secretariat aide Liu Zan was made Censor-in-chief; Censor-in-chief Xu Guangyi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of War Yao Yi was made Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 時李嗣源總帳下親軍攻東北隅；
units.en: Li Siyuan led the household guard against the northeast corner;
units.literal: Li Siyuan commanded the personal troops below the tent attacking the northeast corner;

units.zh: 李嗣源壞夾城東北隅，率先掩擊，梁軍大恐，南向而奔，投戈委甲，噎塞行路，斬萬餘級，獲其將副招討使符道昭洎大將三百人，芻粟百萬。
units.en: Li Siyuan breached Jiacity's northeast and charged in; Liang panicked and fled south, shedding arms until the road jammed; over ten thousand were killed; Fu Daozhao and three hundred officers were taken, with a million bundles of fodder.
units.literal: Li Siyuan broke the northeast corner of Jiacity and led the assault; the Liang army was greatly terrified and fled south, casting weapons and armor; the road was choked; more than ten thousand were beheaded; deputy pacification commissioner Fu Daozhao and three hundred great generals were captured, and a million measures of fodder.

units.zh: 五月辛未朔，晨霧晦暝，帝率親軍伏三垂崗下。
units.en: At the xinwei new moon in the fifth month, thick morning fog hid Cunxu's personal troops below Sanchui Ridge.
units.literal: On the first day xinwei of the fifth month, morning fog dark and dim, the Emperor led his personal army in ambush below Sanchui Ridge.

units.zh: 時嗣源遙領鎮州，詰旦，議欲歸藩，上章請罪，安重誨以為不可，語在《明宗紀》中。
units.en: Siyuan still held Zhen at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his post and asked punishment; An Chonghui forbade it—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.
units.literal: At the time Siyuan held Zhenzhou at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his circuit and submitted a memorial asking punishment; An Chonghui held it impossible—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.

units.zh: 己巳，秘書少監姚顗為左散騎常侍，以太子左諭德陸崇為右散騎常侍，以兵部郎中蕭希甫為左諫議大夫，前幽州節度判官呂夢奇為右諫議大夫，以鄴都副留守孫嶽為潁州團練使。
units.en: On jisi Yao Hui became Left Regular Attendant; crown prince mentor Lu Chong became Right Regular Attendant; Xiao Xifu of Military Affairs became Left Remonstrator; Lü Mengqi, former Youzhou aide, became Right Remonstrator; Sun Yue, Yedu deputy regent, became Ying training commissioner.
units.literal: On jisi, Vice Director of the Secretariat Yao Hui was made Left Regular Attendant; the crown prince's Left Mentor Lu Chong was made Right Regular Attendant; Bureau of Military Affairs director Xiao Xifu was made Left Remonstrator; former Youzhou military commissioner's aide Lü Mengqi was made Right Remonstrator; Yedu deputy regent Sun Yue was made Yingzhou training commissioner.

units.zh: 進封河南尹兼河陽節度使張全義為魏王，兩浙節度使錢鏐進封吳越王。
units.en: Zhang Quanyi of Henan and Heyang was raised to Prince of Wei; Qian Liu of the two Zhes to King of Wu and Yue.
units.literal: Zhang Quanyi, Henan Prefect concurrently military governor of Heyang, was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei; Qian Liu, military governor of the two Zhe circuits, was advanced and enfeoffed as King of Wu and Yue.

units.zh: 五月，以唐朝宰臣張文蔚、楊涉並為門下侍郎、平章事；
units.en: In the fifth month former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;
units.literal: In the fifth month, former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;

units.zh: 從璨，明宗諸子。
units.en: Congcan was one of Mingzong's sons.
units.literal: Congcan was among Emperor Mingzong's sons.

units.zh: 天成中，為右衛大將軍，時安重誨方秉事權，從璨亦不之屈，重誨嘗以此忌之。
units.en: During Tiancheng he was Grand General of the Right Guard. An Chonghui then held power, and Congcan would not bow to him; Chonghui resented him for it.
units.literal: During Tiancheng he was Grand General of the Right Guard; at that time An Chonghui held governmental power, and Congcan would not yield to him—Chonghui often resented him for this.

units.zh: 明宗幸汴，留從璨為大內皇城使。
units.en: When Mingzong visited Bian, he left Congcan as commissioner of the inner imperial city.
units.literal: When Emperor Mingzong visited Bian, he left Congcan as commissioner of the inner imperial city.

units.zh: 詔曰：「皇城使從璨，朕巡幸汴州，使警大內。
units.en: An edict declared, "Imperial City Commissioner Congcan: when We toured Bianzhou We charged him to guard the inner palace.
units.literal: An edict said: "Imperial City Commissioner Congcan—when We toured Bianzhou We ordered him to guard the inner palace.

units.zh: 命復舊官，仍贈太保。
units.en: Congcan's former office was restored and he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: an order restored his former office and posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 從璨為權臣所忌，從益為強敵所脅，俱不得其死，亦良可傷哉！
units.en: Congcan was destroyed by a powerful minister, Congyi was coerced by a strong enemy—neither died a natural death. How lamentable!
units.literal: Congcan was resented by a powerful minister, Congyi was coerced by a strong enemy—neither met a natural death; this too is deeply lamentable!

units.zh: 長興中，重誨之得罪也。
units.en: During Changxing, when Chonghui fell from power,
units.literal: During Changxing, when Chonghui fell from grace,

units.zh: 方當立法，固不黨親，宜貶授房州司戶參軍，仍令盡命。」
units.en: Law must be upheld and kinship cannot shield him. He is demoted to Army Aide of Fangzhou, and his life is forfeit."
units.literal: Now that law is to be upheld, kinship shall not shield him; he should be demoted and appointed Army Aide of Fangzhou, and his life is forfeit."

units.zh: 己卯，以宣義軍節度副大使、知節度事、北面行營副招討等使、特進、檢校太傅霍彥威為天平軍節度副大使，知節度事。
units.en: On jimao, Huo Yanwei—deputy commissioner of Xuanyi, acting military commissioner, deputy northern pacification commissioner, specially advanced, and honorary Grand Mentor—was named deputy commissioner of Tianping with charge of military affairs.
units.literal: On jimao, Xuanyi Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner, Northern Line deputy pacification commissioner, specially advanced, honorary Grand Mentor Huo Yanwei was made Tianping Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner.

units.zh: 貞明三年春正月戊午，以前淄州刺史高允奇為右羽林統軍。
units.en: On wuwu in the first month of Zhenming 3, Gao Yunqi, former Inspector of Zi Prefecture, was appointed commander of the Right Feathered Forest.
units.literal: On wuwu, in the first month of spring of Zhenming 3, former Zi Prefecture Inspector Gao Yunqi was made commander of the Right Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 天成初，除鄴都留守判官，與趙敬怡、呂夢奇不足。
units.en: Early in the Tiancheng era he was made aide to the Ye garrison commander and fell out with Zhao Jingyi and Lü Mengqi.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Tiancheng era he was appointed aide to the Ye garrison commander, and he was on bad terms with Zhao Jingyi and Lü Mengqi.

units.zh: 或達於重誨，會敬怡入為樞密使，與夢奇同構殺之。
units.en: Word of this reached An Chonghui. When Jingyi entered the capital as director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, he and Mengqi together plotted to have Nie killed.
units.literal: Some of this reached An Chonghui. When Jingyi entered the capital as director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, he joined with Mengqi in plotting Nie's death.

units.zh: 庚午，以前華州節度使李從昶為左驍衛大將軍，以前夔州節度使安崇阮為右驍衛大將軍，以前新州節度使翟璋為右領軍上將軍，以右領軍上將軍羅周敬為右威衛上將軍。
units.en: On gengwu former military commissioners Li Congchang of Huazhou, An Chongruan of Kuizhou, and Zhai Zhang of Xinzhou were promoted to senior guard commands, while Luo Zhoujing moved from supreme general of the Right Leading Army to supreme general of the Right Majestic Guard.
units.literal: On gengwu former Huazhou military commissioner Li Congchang was made Left Martial Valiant senior general; former Kuizhou military commissioner An Chongruan was made Right Martial Valiant senior general; former Xinzhou military commissioner Zhai Zhang was made Right Army of the Lead supreme general; Right Army of the Lead supreme general Luo Zhoujing was made Right Majestic Guard supreme general.

units.zh: 天成三年十一月，太常定唐少帝為昭宣光烈考皇帝，廟號景宗。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Tiancheng 3, the Court of Imperial Rites fixed the posthumous title of the Tang Lesser Emperor as the August and Illustrious, Bright and Majestic Imperial Father, with temple name Jingzong.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Tiancheng, the Court of Imperial Rites fixed the posthumous title of the Tang Lesser Emperor as the August and Illustrious, Bright and Majestic Imperial Father, with temple name Jingzong.

units.zh: 四年五月，中書門下奏：「先據太常寺定少帝謚昭宣光烈孝皇帝，號景宗者。
units.en: In the fifth month of the fourth year, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "Previously the Court of Imperial Rites fixed the Lesser Emperor's posthumous title as the August, Illustrious, Bright, and Majestic Filial Emperor, with the designation Jingzong.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "Previously, according to the Court of Imperial Rites, the Lesser Emperor's posthumous title was fixed as the August, Illustrious, Bright, and Majestic Filial Emperor, with the designation Jingzong.

units.zh: 於理而論，祧一遠廟，安少帝神主於太廟，即昭穆序而宗祀正。
units.en: In principle, removing one distant temple and installing the Lesser Emperor's tablet in the Imperial Ancestral Temple would set zhao-mu order aright and make ancestral worship correct.
units.literal: In terms of principle, removing one distant temple and installing the Lesser Emperor's spirit tablet in the Imperial Ancestral Temple would set zhao-mu order aright and make ancestral worship correct.

units.zh: 兼冊文內有『基』字，是玄宗廟諱，雖尋常詔敕皆不回避，少帝是繼世之孫，不欲斥列聖之諱，今改『基』為『宗』字。」
units.en: Moreover, the writ contains the character 'ji,' the temple taboo of Emperor Xuanzong; although ordinary edicts do not avoid it, the Lesser Emperor is a descendant in succession and we do not wish to pronounce the taboos of successive sages—'ji' is now changed to 'zong.'"
units.literal: Moreover, within the writ text is the character 'ji,' which is the temple taboo of Emperor Xuanzong; although ordinary edicts do not avoid it, the Lesser Emperor is a descendant in succession and we do not wish to pronounce the taboos of successive sages—now 'ji' is changed to the character 'zong."

units.zh: 伏以景宗皇帝，頃負沈冤，歲月深遠，園陵已修，不祔於廟，則景宗皇帝親在七廟之外。
units.en: We observe that Emperor Jingzong long bore a deep wrong; years have passed and the imperial tomb has been repaired—if he is not enshrined in the temple, he remains outside the seven temples.
units.literal: Your subjects observe that Emperor Jingzong long bore a deep wrong; the years are distant; the imperial tomb has been repaired—if he is not enshrined in the temple, then Emperor Jingzong's person remains outside the seven temples.

units.zh: 伏以景宗生曾為帝，饗乃承祧，既號景宗，合入宗廟，如不入宗廟，難以言宗。
units.en: We observe that Jingzong in life was once emperor; offerings continue the ancestral line—having been called Jingzong, he should enter the ancestral temple; if he does not, the title 'zong' is hard to justify.
units.literal: Your subjects observe that Jingzong in life was once emperor; offerings continue the ancestral line—having been called Jingzong, he should enter the ancestral temple; if he does not enter the ancestral temple, it is difficult to speak of 'zong.'

units.zh: 今或且居別廟，即請不言景宗，但雲昭宣光烈孝皇帝。
units.en: If for now he dwells in a separate temple, we request not using the name Jingzong but only the August, Illustrious, Bright, and Majestic Filial Emperor.
units.literal: If for now he dwells in a separate temple, it is requested not to speak of Jingzong but only of the August, Illustrious, Bright, and Majestic Filial Emperor.

units.zh: 至是，既立為景宗，陵號溫陵，乃於曹州置廟，以時告享，仍以本州刺史以下為三獻官。
units.en: By then he had been established as Jingzong, with tomb designation Wenling; a temple was set up in Cao Prefecture for timely offerings, with the prefect and officials below serving as the three-offering officials.
units.literal: By this time, having been established as Jingzong, with tomb designation Wenling, a temple was set up in Cao Prefecture for timely announcement and offering; the prefect of that prefecture and below were made the three-offering officials.

units.zh: 八月戊申，明宗服兗冕，禦文明殿，追冊昭宣光烈孝皇帝。
units.en: On the day wushen of the eighth month, Mingzong wore the yan cap and robe, took the throne at the Hall of Civilization, and posthumously enregistered the August, Illustrious, Bright, and Majestic Filial Emperor.
units.literal: On the day wushen of the eighth month, Mingzong wore the yan cap and robe, took the throne at the Hall of Civilization, and posthumously enregistered the August, Illustrious, Bright, and Majestic Filial Emperor.

units.zh: 設如自我作古，酌於人情，則謂之為「景宣光烈」，深不稱也。
units.en: Suppose one were to create new precedent and weigh human sentiment—then to call him 'Jing Xuan Guang Lie' would be deeply unfitting.
units.literal: Suppose one were to create new precedent and weigh human sentiment—then to call him 'Jing Xuan Guang Lie' would be deeply unfitting.

units.zh: 且輝王纂嗣之日，國命出於賊臣，君父銜冤，母後塗炭，遭罹放逐，鼎祚覆亡，追謚易名，當循故實。
units.en: Moreover, when King Hui succeeded to the throne, the nation's mandate issued from treacherous ministers; father and lord bore wrong, the empress dowager suffered ruin, he met exile, and the dynasty fell—posthumous titles should follow established precedent.
units.literal: Moreover, on the day when King Hui succeeded to the throne, the nation's mandate issued from treacherous ministers; father and lord bore wrong, the empress dowager suffered ruin, he met with exile, and the imperial vessel was overturned—posthumous titles and changed names should follow established precedent.

units.zh: 今輝王亡國墜業，謂之「宣景」，得無謬乎！
units.en: Now King Hui lost the state and let the enterprise fall—calling him 'Xuan Jing'—is this not absurd!
units.literal: Now King Hui lost the state and let the enterprise fall—calling him 'Xuan Jing'—is this not absurd!

units.zh: 乃於曹州立廟。
units.en: A temple was then established in Cao Prefecture.
units.literal: A temple was then established in Cao Prefecture.

units.zh: 後宰臣知其非，奏去廟號。
units.en: Later the chief ministers knew this was wrong and memorialized to remove the temple name.
units.literal: Later the chief ministers knew this was wrong and memorialized to remove the temple name.

units.zh: 時議者以追尊則可，立之為宗，不入太廟，深為失禮。
units.en: Contemporary commentators held that posthumous elevation was permissible, but establishing him as 'zong' without entering the Imperial Ancestral Temple was a serious lapse in ritual.
units.literal: Contemporaries who deliberated held that posthumous elevation was permissible, but establishing him as 'zong' without entering the Imperial Ancestral Temple was deeply a lapse in ritual.

units.zh: 臣等切詳故實，欲請立景宗皇帝廟於園所，命使奉冊書寶綬，上謚於廟，便奉太牢祀之，其四時委守奉薦。
units.en: We have examined precedent in detail and request establishing Emperor Jingzong's temple at the mausoleum grounds, ordering envoys to present the tablet, writ, seal, and cord, confer the posthumous title at the temple, and offer the grand sacrifice; guardians shall perform seasonal offerings through the four seasons.
units.literal: Your subjects have examined precedent in detail and wish to request establishing Emperor Jingzong's temple at the mausoleum grounds, ordering envoys to present the tablet, writ, seal, and cord, confer the posthumous title at the temple, and immediately offer the grand sacrifice; the four seasons shall be entrusted to guardians for seasonal offerings.

units.zh: 今昭宣上去玄宗十四世，奏改冊文，非典故也。）〉
units.en: From the August and Illustrious up to Emperor Xuanzong are fourteen generations; memorializing a change to the writ text is not according to precedent.)〉
units.literal: Now from the August and Illustrious up to Emperor Xuanzong are fourteen generations; to memorialize changing the writ text is not according to precedent.)〉

units.zh: 庚戌，以皇城使、行袁州刺史李從敏為陝州節度使。
units.en: On gengxu Li Congmin, palace commissioner and acting Yuan prefect, became Shaan commissioner.
units.literal: On gengxu, Li Congmin, palace commissioner and acting Yuanzhou prefect, was made Shaan military commissioner.

units.zh: 既而襄陽安從進遣行軍司馬張朏，會復州兵於要路以僥之，李金全承詔繼至，暉遂掠城中財帛士女，欲奔江南，尋為其下所殺。
units.en: Before long An Congjin of Xiangyang dispatched the campaign marshal Zhang Fei to join Fuzhou troops at a strategic point to intercept him; Li Jinquan arrived by imperial order in succession. Hui then plundered the city's wealth, goods, and women and intended to flee to Jiangnan; soon he was killed by his subordinates.
units.literal: Before long An Congjin of Xiangyang dispatched the campaign marshal Zhang Fei to join Fuzhou troops at a strategic point to intercept him; Li Jinquan arrived by imperial order in succession; Hui then plundered the city's wealth, goods, and women and intended to flee to Jiangnan; soon he was killed by his subordinates.

units.zh: 金全至，盡誅其黨。
units.en: When Jinquan arrived, he executed all his faction to the last man.
units.literal: When Jinquan arrived, he executed all his faction to the last man.

units.zh: 以禮部尚書王正言為戶部尚書，以御史中丞崔協為禮部尚書，以刑部侍郎、史館修撰、判館事崔居儉為御史中丞，以尚書左丞歸靄為刑部侍郎。
units.en: Wang Zhengyan, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Revenue; Cui Xie, censor-in-chief, was made Minister of Rites; Cui Jujian, Vice Minister of Punishments, History Office compiler, and acting institute director, was made censor-in-chief; and Gui Ai, Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Minister of Punishments.
units.literal: Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan was made Minister of Revenue; censor-in-chief Cui Xie was made Minister of Rites; Punishments vice minister, History Office compiler, and acting institute director Cui Jujian was made censor-in-chief; Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Gui Ai was made Punishments vice minister.

units.zh: 樞密院直學士、守工部侍郎閻至，樞密院直學士、守尚書右丞史圭，並轉戶部侍郎，依前充職。
units.en: Yan Zhi and Shi Gui—privy regular academics—became vice revenue ministers at rank.
units.literal: Privy Council regular academician and acting Vice Minister of Works Yan Zhi, and Privy Council regular academician and acting Right Secretariat director Shi Gui, were both transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue, continuing at their posts.

units.zh: 高祖聖文章武明德孝皇帝，其父臬捩雞，本出於西夷，自朱邪歸唐，從朱邪入居陰山。
units.en: Gaozu, the Sagely, Literary, Martial, Virtuous, and Filial Emperor, was born to Niezhji. The family sprang from western tribes; they left the Zhuye for Tang service and settled with them in the Yin Mountains.
units.literal: Gaozu, the Sagely, Literary, Martial, Virtuous, and Filial Emperor—his father was Niezhji. He was originally of the western barbarians; from the Zhuye he submitted to Tang and, with the Zhuye, came to dwell in the Yin Mountains.

units.zh: 其後，晉王李克用起於雲、朔之間，臬捩雞以善騎射，常從晉王征伐有功，官至洺州刺史。
units.en: When Li Keyong, Prince of Jin, raised his banners in Yun and Shuo, Niezhji rode with him as a crack horse-archer, won repeated credit in the field, and rose to prefect of Ming.
units.literal: Later the Jin Prince Li Keyong rose between Yun and Shuo. Niezhji, skilled in mounted archery, often followed the Jin Prince on campaigns with merit, and reached the office of prefect of Ming.

units.zh: 臬捩雞生敬瑭，其姓石氏，不知其得姓之始也。
units.en: Niezhji’s son was Jingtang. The clan took the surname Shi; when or how they first bore it is not recorded.
units.literal: Niezhji begat Jingtang. Their surname was Shi; the beginning of how they obtained the surname is unknown.

units.zh: 考紹雍謚曰孝元，廟號獻祖，妣何氏謚曰孝元懿。
units.en: his father Shaoyong as Offering Ancestor, Filial Origin; his mother Lady He, Filial Origin Exemplary.
units.literal: his father Shaoyong was given the posthumous title Filial Origin and temple name Offering Ancestor; his mother Lady He was given the posthumous title Filial Origin Exemplary.

units.zh: 時右衛上將軍婁繼英請之，會繼英得罪，乃詔左衛上將軍安崇阮收葬焉。
units.en: Lou Jiying requested the head; when he fell from favor, An Chongruan of the Left Guard was ordered to bury it.
units.literal: At the time Right Guard senior general Lou Jiying requested it; when Jiying fell into guilt, an edict ordered Left Guard senior general An Chongruan to collect and bury it.

units.zh: 晉天福二年五月，詔太社先藏唐朝罪人首級，許親屬及舊僚收葬。
units.en: In Tianfu 2 of Later Jin, kin and former officials might reclaim Tang heads stored at the Grand Altar.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Tianfu 2 of Jin, an edict said that heads of Tang criminals formerly stored at the Grand Altar might be reclaimed by kin and old subordinates.

units.zh: 壬申，黔南節度使楊漢章棄城奔忠州，為董璋所攻也。
units.en: On renshen Yang Hanzhang of Qiannan abandoned his post and fled to Zhong—attacked by Dong Zhang.
units.literal: On renshen Qiannan military commissioner Yang Hanzhang abandoned his post and fled to Zhong—attacked by Dong Zhang.
